title: Road Trip in Albay Philippines (with Erwan Heussaff) Forager Episode 1
description:
Bicol is a beautiful region in the Philippines that is made up of six provinces, namely: Albay, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Catanduanes, Masbate, and Sorsogon. Erwan Heussaff is in Albay and is making a few stops to get a taste of the local flavors as he draws some cooking inspiration before he sets up camp for the night. This is an adventure that we will never forget as we were literally met with a typhoon as we were just about to leave for Catanduanes. Stay with us until the end to get a glimpse of our campsite!

The Ford Ranger Wildtrak  is a top off-roader, powered by a 2L Bi-Turbo Diesel Engine with 210 PS and 500 Newton Meters of Torque. Its advanced Terrain Management System and Trail Control technology provide optimized handling across various terrains, while 9.5-inch ground clearance and a high-strength steel frame ensure durability and control on rugged landscapes.  The other car we are driving is the Ford Ranger Raptor and is for the more seasoned off roaders with added comfort, FOX suspension and Rear Electronic Locking Differential. Learn more about the Ford Ranger at ford.to/RangerPH

This is the first video of our latest three-part Forager series in Bicol, so make sure you subscribe to our channel to get first dibs on the latest videos.
